title: Integer block expert projections in crit's declared order: 4-bit weights against per-block quantized activations, decode rows and a prompt GEMM with the CPU rows' bits

rows.what: decode rows on CUDA cores: a half-warp per output row, dp4a block sums, lane b % 16 in block order, the halving tree; every token of a job reads the row once; an alias of decode-gemv's rows-int-block (the Python rows forward there: the same kernel, the same bits; this structure's tuning applies to it, its sweep tunes it)

THREADS.what: threads a block, a half-warp an output row

ROWS.what: output rows a half-warp owns, a token's activation block read once for them

UNROLL.what: blocks a lane loads before computing them (loads in flight)

yardstick.library: cuBLAS (torch.matmul) BF16 on the weights widened to BF16 and the INT8 activations dequantized to BF16, both once: no library multiplies E2M1 weights by INT8 activations in blocks of 32

gemm.what: prompt GEMM on int8 tensor cores: m16n8k16 tiles sharing an A fragment, exact block sums, the declared FP32 step per block in registers, lanes folded into the halving tree as they finish

TILES.what: m16n8k16 tiles (8 weight rows each) a warp runs on one A fragment

TOKZ.what: 16-token tiles a block takes along grid.z

yardstick.library: cuBLASLt NVFP4 block-scaled GEMM (torch._scaled_mm, FP4 tensor cores) on the stored codes and E4M3 scales, the INT8 activations re-quantized to NVFP4 once: no library takes INT8 activations in blocks of 32 against 4-bit weights

gemm-staged.what: prompt GEMM with shared-memory staging: a CTA BM weight rows x BN tokens, the 16-element blocks visited lane by lane in the tree's order through a STAGES-deep ring (tokens by cp.async, weight codes decoded to int8 once a CTA), a warp BM / WM rows x BN / WN tokens by ldmatrix (one s8 m16n8k16 MMA a 16 x 8 tile and block onto an FP32 bias), each lane folded into the tree as it finishes: the declared order's bits, the same as gemm, rows and the CPU rows

WM.what: warps along the rows (a warp BM / WM rows)

WN.what: warps along the tokens (a warp BN / WN tokens)

GROUP.what: lanes of the tree a stage carries a block of (sibling lanes folded together: fewer barriers a block)

RUN.what: blocks of each lane a stage carries, in the lane's order (fewer barriers a block, no more registers)

STAGES.what: stages of the shared-memory ring (STAGES - 1 in flight; one value swept, the template takes 3 and more)

yardstick.library: cuBLASLt NVFP4 block-scaled GEMM (torch._scaled_mm, FP4 tensor cores) on the stored codes and E4M3 scales, the INT8 activations re-quantized to NVFP4 once: no library takes INT8 activations in blocks of 32 against 4-bit weights

declared-quantizers.what: the declared E2M1 x 2 and INT8 activation quantizers and SwiGLU, a thread per block or element

gemm-native.what: prompt GEMM accumulated in the tensor cores, NOT the declared order, on NVFP4-packed activations (quantize_nvfp4): a CTA TM tokens x TN weight rows. E2M1 weights on sm_120a: warp-specialized (a producer warp's bulk copies into a STAGES-deep ring of mbarrier-guarded stages, rows padded for conflict-free ldmatrix; WM x WN consumer warps' kind::mxf4nvf4 block-scaled m16n8k64 MMAs with UE4M3 scales per 16 on both operands), persistent CTAs in a grouped order, split-K for short prompts, FP32 or BF16 output with the global scale and optional column scales in the epilogue, row-major or cuBLASLt-tiled scale bytes. INT4 weights and other GPUs: a cp.async ring of swizzled BK-byte tiles (kernel core tile.cuh) and the s8 MMA a 16-block with the scales on the CUDA cores. An output's bits depend on the tile, the split and the token count

TN.what: weight rows a CTA (the MMA's N)

WM.what: warps along the tokens (a warp TM / WM tokens)

WN.what: warps along the weight rows (a warp TN / WN rows)

BK.what: bytes of every row a stage (the K step of the ring)

STAGES.what: stages of the ring (the warp-specialized path: as many as fit in shared memory up to this; the cp.async path on other GPUs: 3 or 4, STAGES - 1 in flight)

GROUP.what: weight-row tiles a group of the CTA order (the CTAs that run together share their rows)

EPI.what: sm_120a (BF16 output, whole tiles): 0 stores from registers, 1 each warp's 16-row slices through a shared-memory box and TMA stores, 2 the same with two boxes a warp; other GPUs (FP32 output): 0 from registers, 1 through shared memory as whole rows

SPLIT.what: sm_120a: 0 stream-K (the tiles shared out over the CTAs k-iteration by k-iteration, each tile's segments' partials added in segment order by its last) for launches whose tiles fill at most half the CTAs with K of 64 stages or more, 1 every tile whole, 2 stream-K for the tiles past every launch's last whole wave

gemm-native.order: the tensor core's: each MMA sums its 64 values (four scale blocks) with their scales into the FP32 accumulator, in increasing K (not the declared per-lane order and tree)

yardstick.library: cuBLASLt's NVFP4 block-scaled GEMM (torch._scaled_mm, FP4 tensor cores) on the same codes and E4M3 scale bytes as the kernel (activations tiled to its 128 x 4 layout once outside the timed call), BF16 output like the kernel's
